colors._note: Rep 5 (HR overview): calm corporate HR, palette carried over from the original HR OVERVIEW report (brd.md section 7). Deep slate-teal leads (sidebar, hero KPI, KPI values); teal marks the current period, hires and improvements; red marks terminations and declines; slate is the neutral accent (last year, salary). teal (4.0:1 on white, 3.5:1 on its tint) and slate/slateLight are for marks only; text on tints uses tealDark (5.3:1) and red (5.1:1). All text pairs are 4.5:1 or better. tealMid is the heatmap's top colour: text (#1D2733) on it is 5.9:1, so every cell keeps dark text (fix round 1: a font-colour measure in the matrix drew white everywhere). accent (= red) and warning (= slate) are aliases that gen_theme.py reads for the theme's sentiment colours.

polarity._note: Which way is an improvement, per base measure (brd.md section 4). up = higher is better; down = lower is better; neutral = no good/bad colour (salary is a cost, not an improvement).

chart._note: Series order for the theme's dataColors, as names from colors. Current period / hires / stayers = teal, terminations / leavers = red, last year and salary = slate.

fontPt._note: Power BI sizes in points: font px x 0.75, halves round up; caption raised from 9 to 10 for legibility (Rep 1 lesson).

pbiShadow._note: Rep 3 review: Power BI draws the CSS shadow darker, so visuals use this lighter mapping (colour from shadow). Rep 5: cards have no border; the shadow carries the edge.

container._note: Cards with a title and subtitle use paddingTop 14 (sides and bottom 20), so the title sits higher and the chart gets the space.

control._note: Slicers and buttons (px), pill-shaped (radius = half height). Button slicers under ~40px need padding.default Custom 0 top/bottom (CLAUDE.md). Dropdowns with a header need 76px (known-gaps).

tags._note: Wireframe tags (press T): what each visual is built with. native = Power BI visual and settings; svg = DAX measure returning an SVG image (ImageUrl) shown in a native card or table; html = HTML Content custom visual fed by a DAX measure.

sidebar._note: Full-height navigation and filter rail (columns 1-2, full bleed to the half gutter before column 3).
